dataset_name: Jewel City League V Draft Brain
market_rule: Yahoo Draft Analysis is the market-price source. yahoo_adp contains only values captured from Yahoo/Yahoo-linked data supplied or verified in this project. Missing Yahoo values are null; no substitute, consensus substitution, or estimated ADP is used.
ranking_rule: our_rank is the league-specific decision rank. Boone is an anchor; analyst transcripts, injury/role evidence, Yahoo price and 14-team full-PPR scarcity can move players away from Boone.

core: Protect against RB tier cliffs because 28 RBs start before flexes in a 14-team league.
Use Yahoo ADP as market price; do not follow it as a ranking.
Do not force QB early, but do not allow the last preferred QB tier to disappear.
Full PPR boosts reliable target volume and receiving backs.
One flex means RB scarcity still matters heavily.
Late bench picks should chase contingent RB and emerging WR ceiling.
Schedule is a meaningful early-season tiebreaker, not a reason for large rank jumps.
Weeks 15-17 schedule is a light tiebreaker only because preseason playoff-SOS forecasts are unstable.
Suppress K and DST until late.

slot_notes.early: Long waits between turns increase tier-cliff urgency. Take the last player in a critical tier rather than assuming he returns.
slot_notes.middle: Most flexible. Let value fall while reacting quickly to RB/QB tier endings.
slot_notes.late: Pair picks: one scarcity/tier-cliff player plus one best value/upside player.

draft_logic.yahoo_missing_rule: If yahoo_adp is null, do not invent a market price. Recommend from our_rank, tier, roster need, scarcity, tags, and target_round. If a real Yahoo ADP is later entered, use it immediately for WAIT/TAKE value logic.

dst_streaming.note: Boone's preferred multi-week opening streamer. Drop when schedule turns BUF/SEA/DEN.
Boone's preferred pure Week 1 streamer against Cleveland.
Useful opening stretch around one difficult Dallas matchup.

dst_avoid_early.reason: Elite real defense but KC/JAC/LAR/SF opening schedule makes early fantasy price unattractive.

kicker_strategy.rule: Draft kicker only in the final round or near-final round. Do not carry multiple kickers.
